div.div: 2 سَبَّطَتْ , (M, K, &c.,) inf. n. تَسْبِيطٌ, (S, K,) She (a camel, AZ, As, M, K, and a ewe, K) cast her young one, or fœtus, in an incomplete state: (M, K:) or before its form was apparent; (AZ, K;) like أَجْهَضَتْ and رَجَعَتْ: (AZ:) or when its fur had grown, before completion; as also سَبَّغَتٌ: (As, TA:) or سبّطت بِوَلَدِهَا she (a camel) cast her young one when its hair had grown: and سبّطت she (a ewe) cast her young one, or fœtus, abortively. (S.) The epithet applied to her in this case is ↓ مُسَبِّطٌ [without ة]. (M, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
